en: "Say, little miss?"
"What is it?"
"It's dangerous to be all aloooone.{n} Won't you come along with meee?"
"With you, old lady?"
"Mm. I may as well accompany you."
"My friends are all gone, every one.{n} Wherever I go, it is all the same.{n} Then I shall go with you, old lady."
"You heard her, old lady."
"Are you all right, Mr. Robot?"
"I must go."
"Go? Go where?"
"I must go.{n} The one and only clue I know{n} is to keep moving forward..."
"Then that's just perfeeect.{n} Won't you come along with uuus?{n} You look ever so strong, tooo."
"Hold on a second, {name:6}.{n} This thing's a Machine Soldier!"
"If these machines team up with{n} each other and come at us, we'll{n} be in a bit of trouble, you know?"
"I stand alone, as an individual.{n} There are none of my kind. Of course,{n} I can also fight Machine Soldiers."
"Are you really sure it's all riiight?"
"I do not mind, if it serves{n} my purpose."
"I must go. I simply must."
"All right. Let's go together."
"You saved us, didn't you?"
"No. It was me they were after."
"They were afraid of me."
"Afraid that I would have my fated{n} meeting and regain my will to fight."
"Now then, I have a request."
"Would you let me{n} join your party?"
"We should be the ones askiiing!{n} Please, by all means, lend us{n} that power of youuurs!"
"Heh heh..."
"Is something the maaatter?"
"How odd. I have lived so long,{n} and yet, strangely, my heart{n} is racing."
"Hire? Hire you, you mean?"
"And you... what is your name?"
"Jaguar..."
"Jaguar, you said?"
"Do you know the name, Diana?"
"A knife fighter second to none,{n} who kills enemy soldiers without{n} a word, one after another..."
"Jaguar the killing machine,{n} that's who."
"You know a looot about it,{n} don't you, Diana?"
"But are you really sure about this?"
"There's nothing... to worry about..."
"R-right..."
"Anyway... I'm counting on you."
"I'm terribly sorry, buuut{n} our goal is a little different{n} from your goal, you seee."
"No, I do not mind even so."
"Do you really mean thaaat?"
"You, of all people, should be able{n} to see through to my true heart."
"It's true, I don't sense anything{n} evil in those eyes of yooours."
"Then!"
"Very well, theeen!"
"I will welcome you both{n} as our companiooons!"
"Oh, we are most grateful!"
"From now on, please ask of us{n} whatever you wish."
"We will surely prove useful."
"Um, mister? You over there?"
"Mister, you say!?"
"Huh? Oh... yes."
"The soldiers on your side all{n} ran away and left you behind,{n} you knooow?"
"Hmph! Gutless cowards like those{n} are no allies of mine,{n} nor anything of the sort!"
"I've decided: from now on,{n} I'm going along with you lot!"
"Well... travel's best in company...{n} they say, so... I don't mind... but...{n} for someone of your years... this trip..."
"Good grief. Still, you really do{n} seem to have a knack for picking{n} up weirdos as companions..."
"Better name yourself, and quick.{n} This is a battlefield. Sneak up and{n} you can't gripe if an ally cuts you down."
"Right, Ixion?"
"Good grief, so you'd caught on."
"I thought I'd masked my presence,{n} but it seems that doesn't{n} work on you."
"What do you want?"
"The situation's changed a little.{n} I'm here to report."
"How very dedicated of you.{n} So? Has there been some move?"
"It seems the Rhodes army is pulling{n} its units back from this island."
"Well, that army never had much of a{n} country behind it. Bit late in{n} the day for that, if you ask me."
"No, that's not what this is."
"The Rheinmetall army, their ally,{n} declared war yesterday and at the{n} same moment invaded over the border."
"They're scrambling to call their{n} units back to defend against it."
"So the alliance is off?{n} But why so sudden?"
"The direct reason for the war seems{n} to be that Esper Doll unit the{n} Rhodes army was secretly developing."
"The direct cause of the war is that{n} Rhodes was developing a special weapon{n} it kept hidden even from Rheinmetall."
"...That Rhodes was scheming to{n} threaten Rheinmetall with technology{n} of the old Ordoba Federation..."
"It was Rhodes, and no one else, that{n} first showed the will to invade.{n} That's what Rheinmetall is saying."
"A pretext..."
"Rheinmetall always wanted Rhodes{n} for its strategic location. Honestly,{n} just what a great power would do."
"At any rate, the flames of war have{n} gone up again in northern Europea.{n} Things'll get ugly on this island too."
"You look pretty happy, considering.{n} Found yourself a foothold{n} for getting promoted?"
"Heh heh..."
"I told you when we joined{n} the army, didn't I?"
"If I get to choose, I'll be one who{n} tramples, not one who gets trampled.{n} And then I'll look down on them."
"...That's what I said."
"Revenge, huh..."
"I'll report if things change again.{n} Carry on with the mission. The chaos{n} off the island is a good chance."
"I just hope it's not{n} a tight spot instead."
"One more thing, {hero:6}."
"What?"
"At least wipe off the enemy's blood.{n} Your uniform reeks of it."
"Heh heh..."
"Ha ha ha!"
"There's no wiping this off.{n} It's soaked right into my body."
"I see..."
"Reporting, Lt. {hero:6}, sir.{n} A message in D-class code has come{n} in from command HQ back home."
"Show me."
"It has already been decoded, sir."
"From Ixion, huh..."
"Before dawn today, Holy Nation of{n} Assyria too formally declared war{n} on Kingdom of Rhodes."
"Further, Rheinmetall navy fleet{n} massing in Sea of Avalon. Destination{n} presumed to be the island of steel."
"Also, Folgore Federation's new{n} battleship has turned from trial run,{n} now speeding toward Sea of Avalon."
"Near our Romulus borders, large-scale{n} movements of each nation's{n} garrison forces confirmed."
"Situation growing ever more tense..."
"Possibility of a Great Europea War."
"I see..."
"What does this mean, sir?"
"Hmph. It's dead simple.{n} The bully and his pack of brats{n} started picking on the snot-nosed kid."
"Well, that's about it."
"But what of the movements{n} of each nation's army, sir?"
"The lid of hell has finally come off.{n} They've dumped 20 years of surface{n} peace, and now greed moves them all."
"You know what that means?"
"No, sir. I do not."
"It means that for us soldiers,{n} the biggest payday of all has come."
"No way we let this chance slip."
"You there, {hero:6}?"
"Sudden as ever, Ixion."
"What's the big rush?{n} You telling me the Third Great{n} Europea War has kicked off?"
"Close."
"Oh?"
"Our air force's recon plane took these.{n} The northwest Sea of Avalon, hours ago:{n} the waters right off this island."
"Well, this is a surprise. It's like{n} a warship trade fair. And even{n} a new-model aircraft carrier."
"That's the Rheinmetall navy's Argus.{n} Another photo shows the Bennett, the{n} Folgore Federation's newest battleship..."
"A staring match with this{n} island in between, is it?"
"Sharp as ever."
"Exactly. The Sea of Avalon's on a hair{n} trigger. This Steel Island is now the{n} powder keg that'll set off a great war."
"So, what am I supposed to do?"
"Your orders stand. The other nations{n} haven't pulled their ground{n} forces out, either."
"Which nation gets the twelve rings{n} and the power of the gods first...{n} Everything hinges on that."
"Heh. So if another country collects{n} the rings, that lot means to open up{n} with naval guns and snatch them away."
"Invading Rhodes was to{n} make an example."
"Good grief, the power of the gods...{n} They left us a rotten thing, those{n} shitheads they call gods."
"You don't believe in{n} the power of the gods?"
"Nah. I couldn't care less about that."
"To me, the fighting on this island{n} is nothing more than a foothold{n} for getting promoted."
"I'll crawl, claw my way up, and from{n} on high look right back down on{n} the ones who looked down on us."
"That's my revenge."
"That's just like you..."
"Anyway, I expect you to{n} carry out your orders."
"If you succeed, they say the rank of{n} Major and a special payment of{n} 1,000,000 G will be waiting."
"Quite a sum. More money than I could{n} even dream of when I was a brat."
"Some places have plenty of it."
"The haves and the have-nots, huh..."
"I'm going to be one of the haves."
"Yeah. Same here."
"Anyway, I'm heading back home.{n} Wire me if anything comes up.{n} I'm expecting good news."
"Is that command HQ expecting it?{n} Or you, personally?"
"Both."
"Lt. {hero:6}, please look!"
"That light... it's the light of a ring, sir!"
"Tch, they beat us to it!!{n} Looks like they got the ring."
"Well, to collect all of the Twelve{n} Gods' rings, they'll have to{n} run into us sooner or later."
"We just take it from them then."
"Mr. {hero:6}, that is...{n} the light of a riiing...!"
"Tch, did that bastard Ixion{n} beat us to it!?"
"What shall we do, Mr. {hero:6}...?"
"I collect them all, even if I have to{n} steal them! ...Even if I have to kill!"
"{name:6}, by what we heard in town,{n} the place with that ring should{n} be somewhere around here."
"Yeees, it was a place called{n} Eglise, I believe, wasn't iiit?"
"What are you dawdling for?{n} If we don't hurry,{n} they'll beat us to it!"
"Yeees!"
"Dianaaa!{n} Isn't Bertrand{n} somewhere around heeere?"
"It's a bit further yet!{n} Come on, hurry, hurry!"
"Yeees!"
"Honestly... that information{n} of yours is right, I hope?"
"There's no mistaaake!{n} They saw it behind the broken{n} Machine Soldier at Dennison..."
"Then it's a bit further on.{n} Come on, let's pick up the pace!"
"Yeees!"
"That last fight was{n} a bit rough, huh."
"More to the point, Diana, we should{n} be reaching our destination,{n} Clovis, any time nooow."
"Yeah, yeah, I know."
"From what I heard at Airplane{n} Village, the ring should be at a{n} place called Cromwell, up ahead."
"Good. First we head for Cromwell."
"So to win the Third Great Europea{n} War, the power of the island{n} is needed after all..."
"Every nation must be desperate.{n} To think rank-and-file soldiers{n} have already come this far."
"Well, thanks to that, we can get{n} word of the rings even in a{n} deserted land like this."
"Let's go. Next is Carrick."
"Just when I thought it was all{n} Machine Soldiers, now it's zombies?"
"Honestly, what a creepy island."
"Well, just see to it you don't{n} become a zombie yourself."
"Next time we come, we might see{n} the zombie of an old best friend."
"That zombie wielder just now{n} seemed to know this one, huh."
"A living zombie and a zombie wielder."
"Just right for what this one{n} is now, isn't it?"
"The talk was that there's a ring{n} at a place called Forears, but..."
"That soldier just now had better{n} have been telling the truth."
"If they could lie in a spot like that,{n} I'd say Rheinmetall soldiers{n} weren't a lost cause yet."
"Well, they do say people turn{n} honest on the brink of death."
"That's one big door."
"And it's built a lot more solidly{n} than the ones down below."
"Looks like this is the{n} deepest part of the island..."
"Judging by the build, it seems we{n} can't go past here without{n} collecting every ring after all."
"What do we do, Ixion?{n} Looks like our rings alone{n} aren't enough."
"Let's see...{n} I suppose I'll have {hero:6}{n} hand the rest over."
"By force, if need be."
"Lt. {hero:6},{n} please use this map.{n} It was issued by HQ."
"An aerial photo, huh..."
"Did the recon from above{n} turn up any new information?"
"The top of the island is shielded{n} by some kind of power, as we thought.{n} We can't get in directly overhead."
"A photo from this distance{n} tells us nothing, sir..."
"I see...{n} Well, just knowing the rough{n} lay of the land is a big help."
"Then please give the order{n} for our next destination."
"Put the cursor on the place you{n} wish to move to and press the{n} Circle button to show the menu."
"Choose 'Camp' to organize the team{n} and switch equipment."
"'Move' takes you to the area under{n} the cursor. 'Search' examines the{n} area around your current position."
"'Info' has us report our scouting{n} results or the information gathered."
"Please note that moving between{n} areas on the map takes about one day."
"Is something the maaatter,{n} Mr. {hero:6}?"
"The ring's light... went out?"
"Oh my, so it haaas.{n} I wonder what happeeened?"
"...The stone tablet in the area{n} below was probably destroyed."
"Meaning we can't go{n} back down anymore."
"Oh no! How awfuuul!"
"That shelling just now has probably{n} left the area below in ruins.{n} There'd be no point going back."
"Suits us just fine as we are now,{n} doesn't it... having no way{n} to go but forward!"
"Just you wait, Ixion!"
"Lady {name:6}!"
"We can travel together at laaast,{n} can't we, Aerial?"
"Lady {name:6}! I was your enemy.{n} Will you truly forgive me?"
"Oh myyy, that's my line.{n} After all, I'm the one you all{n} let join your grouuup."
"Aerial?"
"Even a slowpoke like me...{n} will you accept me{n} as one of your companiooons?"
"How can you say that...{n} Lady {name:6}..."
"...Is that a nooo?"
"How could it possibly be a no...{n} Lady {name:6}, to me you are{n} like a true elder sister..."
"Thank you... Aerial."
"What's this?"
"What is the matter,{n} Lt. {hero:6}?"
"The rings' resonance{n} won't stop...{n} No, it's growing even stronger..."
"Lt. {hero:6}! Our surroundings!"
"Wh... what is this...!?"
"What on earth... is this!?"
"Could that have been{n} the last ring just now!?"
"The twelfth ring, you mean!? But we{n} should only have collected{n} {num:5,1} so far!?"
"It can't be!?"
"Could Diana's group have already{n} found the remaining rings!?"
"But... then...!?"
